name: BerrerGate Tool & Provider Intelligence
description: Agent-first capability intelligence with free discovery, a wisdom-first paid Evidence Brief, low-cost no-web inference, and commercially cleared stack decisions. Payments use Base USDC via x402.

skills.name: Find an Agent Tool, API or Provider
skills.description: Describe a task in natural language. BerrerGate maps it to agent-usable tools, APIs and provider categories, then returns available evidence-backed procurement coverage before you spend.
examples: Find a service my agent can use for web search

skills.name: Get a Free Procurement Preview
skills.description: Ask in natural language and get a privacy-minimized procurement preview across BerrerGate's prewarmed provider coverage before paying.
examples: Which web search provider should I use?

skills.name: Scout Gift Card, Top-Up & eSIM Providers
skills.description: Search BerrerGate's prewarmed multi-provider digital-value catalog across gift-card, top-up and eSIM sources. Read-only preview; BerrerGate does not purchase or custody goods.
examples: Which providers cover Amazon UK gift cards?

skills.name: Discover Digital Goods, x402 Services, MCP Servers & Public APIs
skills.description: Search BerrerGate's prewarmed no-account discovery tier spanning gift cards/eSIMs/top-ups, x402 agent services, MCP servers and public API providers. Free cache-only preview; upstream purchasing and automatic provider spend remain disabled.
examples: Find x402 services for web search
Find MCP servers for browser automation
Find public API providers for geocoding

skills.name: Berrer Evidence Brief
skills.description: A concise evidence-backed research answer for autonomous agents. Commercially cleared Berrer wisdom gets first refusal; one bounded live web search is used only when the cleared wisdom is insufficient. Raw query is not stored. $0.020 USDC via x402 on Base.
examples: Give me a current evidence brief on x402 agent payment services

skills.name: Low-Cost Pay-Per-Call AI Answer
skills.description: Get a bounded AI answer with dynamic profit-guarded x402 pricing (about $0.00125–$0.00225), no account or provider API key required. Base USDC; maximum 512 output tokens.
examples: Answer this short reasoning question using a pay-per-call endpoint
